title: A double-click on a box or ellipse without text opens an empty text field
body: `scene::edit::text_edits` inserts `text "..."` into a node that has none, but acre-gui refuses to open the field there ("the box has no text of its own to edit", 1903650). A double-click on a box or ellipse with no text should open an empty field over it; typing writes the `text` property, and an empty result writes nothing.
close_reason: Landed in b39b9bb: Field::open (crates/acre-gui/src/field.rs) opens an empty field when text_of returns None; the edit path is unchanged, so an empty result writes nothing.
